model_annotation: The grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language families for six different model configurations. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "family," and displays the distinct groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical value axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale with an approximate visible extended range accommodating data and error bars from roughly -5 to 35. Numeric tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 10, displaying 0, 10, 20, and 30, and correspond with horizontal grid lines extending across the plot. Within each language family on the horizontal axis, six bars are arranged side-by-side, corresponding to the configurations listed in the legend: mBERT-L₂ in light blue, XLM-L₂ in dark blue, mBERT-R₂ in light green, XLM-R₂ in dark green, mBERT-B₂ in light pink, and XLM-B₂ in dark red. All bars are outlined in black and are emphasized by the presence of black, capped error bars extending above and in some cases below their primary value. The bar lengths vary notably depending on the family and configuration; the highest values are concentrated in the IE-Indic family, where the light pink mBERT-B₂ bar is the tallest on the chart at approximately 24, followed by the dark red XLM-B₂ bar near 21 and the light green mBERT-R₂ bar near 20. In contrast, families such as Isolate and Uralic present consistently very short bars hovering near zero for all six models. Several bars drop below the zero line, indicating negative effect values, such as the light and dark green R₂ configurations in the Semitic family and the dark blue XLM-L₂ configuration in the IE-Indic family.
